caption:
Your imagination isn't meant for daydreaming. It's the workshop where plans are built.

Most men see the dream. Winners see the steps.

Write them down. That's when imagination becomes power instead of addiction.

The guy who built something started the same way you did, but he imagined the path, not the destination.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
